request._comment: Transit parameter, consumed by this capacity. It may arrive as a value or as a transit reference; the contract declares only its name and schema (/root/llm/schema/request), and it is read through the parameter resolver.

response._comment: Transit result, consumed by the caller (/root/llm/schema/response). Never persisted by this capacity.

#adapt_request.role: Build the Anthropic Messages API request from the canonical request.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes an Anthropic Messages API request.
notes: HTTP method: POST.
API URL: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages.
Header x-api-key: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}.
Header anthropic-version: 2023-06-01.
Header Content-Type: application/json.
request.model -> body.model.
Canonical messages with role 'system' are removed from body.messages and mapped to body.system as ordered text blocks.
Canonical messages with role 'user' or 'assistant' -> body.messages, preserving their order and content.
A message role with no Anthropic Messages API equivalent causes an explicit invalid-request failure.
request.parameters.max_output_tokens -> body.max_tokens.
Anthropic requires max_tokens; if request.parameters.max_output_tokens is absent, this capacity fails rather than inventing a provider-specific generation limit.
request.parameters.temperature -> body.temperature when present.
request.parameters.top_p -> body.top_p when present.
request.parameters.stop -> body.stop_sequences when present.
request.requirements.reasoning -> body.output_config.effort when present and supported.
When request.output.format is absent or 'text', output_config.format is omitted.
When request.output.format is 'json_schema', body.output_config.format = {"type":"json_schema","schema":request.output.schema}.
A schemaless canonical 'json' output has no equivalent contract used by this adapter and causes an explicit invalid-request failure.

A canonical system message with cache true produces a system block carrying cache_control {type: ephemeral}; a user or assistant message with cache true becomes a single text block carrying the same cache_control, so that the history up to that message is read from the cache on the next request. The provider ignores a marker below its minimum cacheable length.

#execute.role: Execute the Anthropic Messages API request asynchronously.

transformation_contract.morphing: An Anthropic Messages API request becomes an Anthropic message response.
notes: Measure duration around the remote API call.
Provider authentication and transport errors become Brique errors.
No credential value is returned or logged by the capacity.

transformation_contract.morphing: An Anthropic message response becomes a canonical inference response.
notes: Collect provider_response.content blocks whose type is 'text' and preserve their order.
For format 'text', response.output.content is the concatenated text.
For format 'json_schema', parse the returned text as JSON and use the parsed value as response.output.content.
response.output.format is the effective canonical output format.
response.resolved.provider = 'anthropic'.
response.resolved.model = provider_response.model.

response.usage.input_tokens = provider_response.usage.input_tokens + provider_response.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens + provider_response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens, treating absent cache fields as zero.
response.usage.output_tokens = provider_response.usage.output_tokens.
response.usage.total_tokens = response.usage.input_tokens + response.usage.output_tokens.
response.finish_reason = provider_response.stop_reason.
response.duration_ms = duration_ms.
response.usage.cached_input_tokens = provider_response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens, treating an absent field as zero.
response.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens = provider_response.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, treating an absent field as zero.

#root.role: Adapt a canonical LLM request to the Anthropic Messages API, execute it asynchronously, and normalize the result to the canonical response schema.

invariants: Canonical message meaning and ordering are preserved.
Anthropic-specific representation remains internal to this capacity.
The capacity is stateless between invocations.
The request and the response are transit values: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.

A transient failure of the provider (a rate limit 429, an overload 529, a server error 5xx, a request timeout 408, a broken connection) is asked again up to three times, waiting longer each time (the Retry-After of the provider when it gives one); any other error is returned at once.
An output cut at max_tokens before its JSON is complete fails with an error that says so, instead of a parsing error.
transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical inference request becomes a canonical inference response produced through Anthropic.

objective.name: infer.anthropic
objective.description: Execute a canonical inference request through the Anthropic Messages API and return a canonical inference response.
